name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench. Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width. Lower the bar to your mid-chest, then press it back up.

name: Barbell Squat
instructions: Rest the barbell on your upper back. Squat down until your thighs are parallel to the floor, then drive back up.

name: Pull-up
instructions: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip. Pull your body up until your chin is over the bar, then lower back down slowly.
